issues.title: This iframe element contains a visible link that is part of its sequential focus navigation order, and has a negative tabindex.
issues.why_it_matters_for_persona: As a keyboard-only user, I cannot access the content inside the iframe, such as the 'Home' link, because the negative tabindex removes the iframe from the tab order. This prevents me from navigating to and interacting with important links or controls.
remediation_instructions: Remove the `tabindex='-1'` attribute from the `<iframe>` element to allow it and its content to be focusable.
Alternatively, if the iframe's content is not meant to be interactive, remove the focusable elements from within it.
expected_tool_change: A keyboard navigation test should show that the 'Home' link inside the iframe is focusable.
An automated tool might report a keyboard accessibility issue.
